verdict.rationale:
Docs show the platform is API-first — agent creation, extraction categories, call summaries, workflows, and telephony are all described as configurable via the API, and a CLI and MCP server both wrap that same API, implying broad parity. However, there is no explicit documentation stating full UI/API feature parity, and probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s), leaving some doubt about completeness of coverage for every UI action.
Missing for 10: explicit UI-API parity statement, published OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent confirmation that all UI actions have API equivalents.
